notes.title: v1.0
notes.content:
[b]The Early Access is coming to an end soon![/b] I released this patch a bit earlier than the official release to playtest it more. Thank you for being a part of this Early Access and for playing the game! I hope you enjoy all the added content, and be sure to let me know if you find any bugs! After the Early Access ends, updates will still come, but at a slower pace.

[h1]Highlights[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]7 challenges have been added to the game![/b] Each of them has a unique achievement when completed! You can see the challenges on the Character Select screen.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/53pzwIv.png[/img]

[*] [b]There are 4 new sprites for EXP chunks now![/b] Previous to this patch, there was one sprite for EXP chunks, but now there are five in total, related to the EXP value of the chunks. The bigger the EXP chunk is, the higher its EXP value!

Here are two examples of new sprites.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/8F2t42B.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/U9Q2Pwn.png[/img]

[*] [b]You can now dash by pressing A on your gamepad![/b] (In addition to the shoulder buttons)
[/list]

[h1]Balance changes[/h1]
[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] EXP given by enemies that were left alive after the wave ends: 60% >>> [b]40%[/b]
[/list]

[h2]Combat Items[/h2]
[h3]Shuriken[/h3]
[list]
[*] Max Health damage dealt to bosses: 2.5% >>> [b]5%[/b]
[/list]

[h2]Trinkets[/h2]
[h3]Dragonfruit[/h3]
[list]
[*] Health restore at the start of each wave: [20, 30, 40] >>> [b][16, 24, 32][/b]
[/list]

notes.title: early access v1.24
notes.content:
[h1]Highlights[/h1]
[list]

[*] [b]Some changes have been made to improve performance, especially in the later waves.[/b] The most impactful changes are the following:
[list]
[*] Changing how the enemy health animation when receiving damage works.
[*] Reducing the frequency at which some enemies shoot projectiles.
[*] Reducing the total amount of enemies that can spawn a bit.
[/list]
The changes included in this patch should make the game's FPS higher under heavy stress.
[*] [b]You can now earn the Gold Rush! achievement by playing in any ascension (even 0) instead of just on Ascension 5.[/b]
[/list]

[h1]Balance changes[/h1]
[h2]Enemies[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Enemies now have +10% health overall, except the final bosses, which have -20% health.[/b]
[*] [b]Enemies now have more speed in the early levels, and more or less the same speed than before this patch at level 4.[/b]
[*] More enemies now spawn in the early waves, to smoothen out the difficulty curve a bit (it was too easy in the early waves, with the difficulty concentrating too much in the later waves)
[*] Enemies now have bigger collision boxes among themselves, so they can't be as close as they were before this patch. They used to mesh together occupying a small amount of space, making them look as if there were fewer enemies than there were, and making area-damage towers much better options than single target towers in practically all cases.
[*] Enemies that dash now have no collisions with other enemies during the dashes, to avoid being blocked.
[*] Enemies are now immune to knockback during dashes, to avoid unexpected trajectories.
[/list]

[*] Starting Strength: 0 >>> [b]5[/b]
[*] Starting Intellect: 0 >>> [b]5[/b]

[h3]Crystal Miner[/h3]
[list]
[*] Cost: 70 >>> [b]60[/b]
[/list]
[h3]Spike Thrower[/h3]
[list]
[*] Cost: 40 >>> [b]30[/b]
[/list]

[list]
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] The health bar below the player now reflects Golden Titan's health well in all cases.
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] The description for the Arcane Lectern can no longer show percentages above 100%.
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] The EXP Gain reduction that Relief Potions give is now shown correctly in the stats panel (it was shown as double the amount that it actually was, but it was just a visual bug, as the EXP got calculated correctly)
[/list]

notes.title: early access v1.8
notes.content:
Hi everyone! This patch should have a big impact on how the game feels, for the better.

[h1]Highlights[/h1]
[list]
[*] Many improvements have been made [b]to reduce visual clutter and to make each element easier to distinguish.[/b] See more info below.
[*] The difficulty curve has been rebalanced to ensure that the amount of enemies in each wave increases progressively. See more info below.
[*] [b]Rerolls have been added to shops.[/b] You have unlimited rerolls, but they cost crystals, and the cost duplicates after each use! The starting cost is 2 crystals and the cap is 999.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/B2J9a5O.png[/img]

[*] Enemies now show their status effects (reduced healing, slowed, stunned).

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4CjtRfx.png[/img]

[*] The shop can't offer more than one copy of each trinket/potion at the same time now.
[*] The shop is now guaranteed to always offer a Small Healing Potion, a Healing Potion or a Relief Potion.
[/list]

[h2]Visual Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Drastically reduced the path tile opacity.[/b]

[b]Before[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/eI6t6Qu.png[/img]

[b]After[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/LRLyxuk.png[/img]

[*] [b]Both the player and enemies now have a small glow effect.[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/603l73X.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/DsUjOWZ.png[/img]

[*] Tower opacity has been dropped an additional 10%.
[*] Some tower projectiles have lower opacity too.
[/list]

[h2]Difficulty progression[/h2]

Before this patch, the amount of enemies in each wave was roughly the following:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RvBXtFv.png[/img]

The sharp declines in waves 7, 13 and 19 were due to how much the enemies scaled when they leveled up. This isn't a very good way to balance them, since the enemy amount is also a big factor regarding how difficult the game feels, not only how much each individual enemy can resist damage.

Now the enemy amount scales this way:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eF1xwNR.png[/img]

In general, each wave will now have more enemies than the previous one. Enemies now scale a lot less when they level up. Also, there are 24 waves now instead of 25, to make each game last a bit less and to have the same number of waves for each enemy level (4 enemy levels, 6 waves for each, 24 waves).

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[h3]Characters[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Golden Titan[/b]
[list]
[*] Regeneration: each second >>> [b]each 1.5 seconds[/b].
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Towers[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Archer[/b]
[list]
[*] Fire rate: 3.5 >>> [b]3[/b]
[*] Damage: 10 (+40% strength) >>> [b]9 (+40% strength)[/b]
[/list]
[*] [b]Card Dealer[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage: 4 (+40% strength) (+40% intellect) >>> [b]8 (+40% strength) (+40% intellect)[/b]
[*] Range: 180 >>> [b]200[/b]
[/list]
[*] [b]Gatling Gun[/b]

[i]Should still be among the top damage dealing towers each wave after these changes, but the scalings were higher than they seemed due to the tower's very high rate of fire.[/i]

[list]
[*] Damage: 8 (+20% strength) (+10% attack speed) >>> [b]5 (+16% strength) (+8% attack speed)[/b]
[/list]
[*] [b]Impact Sprayer[/b]
[list]
[*] Enemy current health magic damage: 5% >>> [b]3%[/b]
[*] Damage: 3 (+10% intellect) >>> [b]6 (+10% intellect)[/b]
[/list]
[*] [b]Magic Launcher[/b]
[list]
[*] Fire rate: 2.5 >>> [b]2.25[/b]
[*] Damage: 16 (+60% intellect) >>> [b]15 (+50% intellect)[/b]
[/list]
[*] [b]Ruthless End[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage: 3 (+20% intellect) >>> [b]2 (+20% intellect)[/b]
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Trinkets[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Portable Anvil[/b]
[list]
[*] Tower cost increase: 20% >>> [b]30%[/b].
[/list]
[*] [b]Crystal Ore[/b]
[list]
[*] Rarity: Common >>> [b]Uncommon[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: early access v1.1
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone! First update for this game, fixing most issues that popped up in the launch day![/b] Thank you all for your feedback, it lets me improve the game much faster! [b]If you're enjoying the game, please consider leaving a review, it helps a LOT![/b] 😊

[h1]Highlights[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]An option has been added to the options menu to show/hide the tower progress bars that indicate the time left for the next shot.[/b] They come hidden by default to reduce visual clutter a bit.
[*] [b]You can no longer receive duplicate copies of some trinkets[/b] (Witch Hat, Golden Guardian, Trinity Shield)
[*] [b]You can now unlock ascensions early using 100 crystals in the Play Menu.[/b]
[*] [b]Moving towers in the shop using a controller or the keyboard works much better now, as the same icon you pressed remains highlighted after the swap.[/b]
[*] The player dash speed is now limited to 1000. (So by default, you reach max dash speed when at 250 speed)
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[h3]Enemies[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Saboteur[/b] (Final Boss)
[list]
[*] Max Health: 40000 >>> [b]60000[/b]
[/list]
[*] [b]Shieldwall[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]The shield now has health[/b]: once it reflects 100 projectiles, the shield breaks in the same way as if you had dashed through it.
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Characters[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Golden Vanguard[/b]
[list]
[*] Dash damage: 20 * level >>> [b]25 + (25 * level)[/b]
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Shop[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Shops now offer 3 potions by default instead of 2.[/b]
[*] Common trinket cost: 60 >>> [b]70[/b]
[*] Rare trinket cost: 140 >>> [b]150[/b]
[/list]
[h3]Towers[/h3]
[list]
[*] Trick Room
[list]
[*] Range: 180 >>> [b]160[/b]
[*] Possible Effects
[list]
[*] Reduce healing [i](unchanged)[/i]
[*] Slow enemies [i](unchanged)[/i]
[*] Stun enemies: 1.0s + (luck * 0.05s) >>> [b]0.3s + (luck * 0.02s)[/b]
[*] Max Health damage to enemies: 10% + (luck * 0.5%) (max: 40%) >>> [b]2% + (luck * 0.2%) (max: 20%)[/b]
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Trinkets[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Aura Shots[/b]
[list]
[*] Extra magic damage: 15% >>> [b]12%[/b]
[/list]
[*] [b]Penetrative Shots[/b]
[list]
[*] Extra physical damage: 15% >>> [b]12%[/b]
[/list]
[*] [b]Black Rune[/b]
[list]
[*] Enemies spawn with less health: -15% >>> [b]-10%[/b]
[/list]
[*] [b]Death Scythe[/b]
[list]
[*] Extra Crit Damage: 100% >>> [b]50%[/b]
[/list]
[*] [b]Demon Soul[/b]
[list]
[*] Chance to gain 1 strength after each enemy death: 3% >>> [b]2%[/b]
[/list]
[*] [b]Golden Emblem[/b]
[list]
[*] Crystals for each trinket in possession: 5 >>> [b]4[/b]
[/list]
[*] [b]Hope[/b]
[list]
[*] Health threshold for activation: 20% >>> [b]30%[/b]
[/list]
[*] [b]Sweet Candy[/b]
[list]
[*] Luck: 5 >>> [b]4[/b]
[*] Max Health: 10 >>> [b]5[/b]
[*] Speed: 10 >>> [b]5[/b]
[*] Strength: 2 >>> [b]1[/b]
[*] Intellect: 2 >>> [b]1[/b]
[*] Range: 5% >>> [b]10%[/b]
[*] Crit Damage: 10% >>> [b]5%[/b]
[*] Armor: 5 >>> [b]4[/b]
[*] [i]Regeneration, Attack Speed, Faith, Evasion and Exp Gain given are unchanged.[/i]
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Bug fix[/b]: Exhauster can no longer level up.
[*] [b]Bug fix[/b]: Shop: Your tower inventory no longer covers a part of the descriptions for the towers when there are 7 towers on sale.
[*] [b]Bug fix[/b]: Golden Vanguard, Golden Titan and Golden Shieldbreaker now start with the correct amount of Equip Slots.
[*] [b]Bug fix[/b]: Evasion wasn't being limited to 75% as the tooltip says.
[/list]
